rich_description: The Merdeka Generation Package is the medical-subsidies and benefits scheme for Singapore citizens born between 1 January 1950 and 31 December 1959 who became citizens on or before 31 December 1996, recognising their contribution to Singapore's growth years. Benefits are smaller than Pioneer Generation's but still substantial: higher outpatient subsidies at polyclinics and CHAS GP and dentist clinics, MediShield Life premium subsidies (partial coverage), MediSave top-ups, and CareShield Life participation incentives. Like Pioneer Generation, enrolment is automatic and the Merdeka Generation card is issued. If your parent or relative is in their mid-60s to mid-70s and has been a citizen since before 1996, they are very likely on the Merdeka scheme rather than Pioneer. Subsidies apply at CHAS-participating clinics islandwide and at all public polyclinics and hospitals.

other_criteria: Obtained Singapore citizenship on or before 31 December 1996
Merdeka Generation card issued automatically — no application required

required_documents.name: NRIC
required_documents.notes: Card issued automatically — physical card is mailed

oth_location: Online via LifeSG app or gov.sg/merdeka; CPF Service Centres and Community Centres assist with enquiries. PLACEHOLDER — verify whether ServiceSG counter at Tampines OTH handles Merdeka Generation enquiries.
typical_processing_time: Automatic — subsidies apply immediately at every clinic visit.
